cues: Two named reactions swap one halogen for another.
The Finkelstein reaction makes iodides from chlorides with sodium iodide in dry acetone, where the sodium chloride precipitates and drives the change.
The Swarts reaction makes fluorides with silver fluoride, which is how freons are made.
text: Two named reactions swap one halogen for another. The Finkelstein reaction makes iodides from chlorides with sodium iodide in dry acetone, where the sodium chloride precipitates and drives the change. The Swarts reaction makes fluorides with silver fluoride, which is how freons are made.
